# flows_project (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a single project by name or ID, so that project IDs don't have to be hard-coded in configuration. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set. The lookup fails if no project matches. Project names are unique within an organization (ignoring case), so a name always resolves to at most one project. Only projects the authentication token has at least viewer access to can be looked up.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a project up by name instead of hard-coding its ID.
data "flows_project" "sandbox" {
  name = "My Personal Sandbox"
}

resource "flows_flow" "example" {
  project_id = data.flows_project.sandbox.id
  name       = "example"
  definition = file("${path.module}/flow.yaml")
}

# Projects can also be looked up by ID to retrieve their metadata.
data "flows_project" "by_id" {
  id = "019c5689-e85c-72e9-9cc8-322de9274ae9"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the project. Set it to look the project up by ID, otherwise it is computed from the lookup by name.
- `name` (String) Name of the project. Set it to look the project up by name (case-insensitive), otherwise it is computed from the lookup by ID.

### Read-Only

- `is_personal_sandbox` (Boolean) Whether the project is a user's automatically created personal sandbox.
